title: docs(types): the ChartSchema chartType row lists the declared ChartType set, pinned against the node's zod enum (objectui#11521)
body:
Fixes #11521

Clause-②: no

The `chartType` row of the `ChartSchema` table in `content/docs/api/schema-reference.md` now lists the `@objectstack/spec` `ChartType` set that the `chart` node declares. A new pin in `@object-ui/types` holds the row equal to that set. It reads the set off the node's zod enum at test time.

Dispatched by the `domain:devx` seat 2 PM under triage's direction (comment `5963348113`) and the seat's claim (comment `5963925327`), session `https://claude.ai/code/session_01HRYqpqGcWpJuJkDmbRF75w`.

## The row, before and after

| | `chartType` description cell |
|---|---|
| before (base `8366accd1`) | **Required.** `"bar"`, `"line"`, `"area"`, `"pie"`, `"donut"`, `"radar"`, `"scatter"`, `"heatmap"`. |
| after | **Required.** One of the `@objectstack/spec` `ChartType` families: `"bar"`, `"horizontal-bar"`, `"column"`, `"line"`, `"area"`, `"pie"`, `"donut"`, `"funnel"`, `"scatter"`, `"treemap"`, `"sankey"`, `"combo"`, `"gauge"`, `"solid-gauge"`, `"metric"`, `"kpi"`, `"bullet"`, `"radar"`, `"table"`, `"pivot"`. Any other value is refused with the set named (objectui#11521). The single-value families draw the first series' value in the first row as one number, and the tabular families draw a notice that points at the data-table and pivot components; the others plot the series. |

The values are in the spec's own order. The pin compares them as a set, so a reorder in the spec does not turn it red.

## Premise check, measured on `origin/main` `8366accd1`

- **D1 holds.** The row read as quoted above.
- **D2 is corrected by measurement.** `ChartType` is the spec's own type (`export type ChartType = SpecChartType` in `packages/types/src/data-display.ts`). The node's mirror declares `chartType` with the spec's `ChartTypeSchema`, which is a zod enum. In the installed `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0 it has twenty families. 17.6.0 has the same twenty (read in objectui#11438's worktree).
- **Both faces accept all twenty.** A probe through `safeValidateSchema` and `StrictAnyComponentSchema` parsed `bar`, `kpi` and `table` green. It refused `heatmap` at `chartType` as one `invalid_value`, and that issue's `values` are the twenty families.
- **The row missed thirteen declared families, not six.** Six are the card's: `funnel`, `treemap`, `sankey`, `combo`, `column` and `horizontal-bar`. The other seven are `gauge`, `solid-gauge`, `metric`, `kpi`, `bullet`, `table` and `pivot`.
- ⚠️ **The ruling's two sentences conflict once measured.** "the six accepted families join it" and "the table's `chartType` values equal the declared `ChartType` set" cannot both hold. This PR follows the pin, which is also the dispatch's direction: derive the set from the type, never from the card's list. The thirteen families that join include the card's six. The conflict is named here, not settled silently.
- **What the seven extra families do on this node.** In plugin-charts' `AdvancedChartImpl`, the single-value families (`SINGLE_VALUE_CHART_TYPES`) draw the first series' value in the first row as one number. The tabular families (`TABULAR_CHART_TYPES`) draw a notice that points at the data-table and pivot components. plugin-charts' `chart-type-spec-parity.test.tsx` holds those branches. The row says this in one sentence and does not list which family is which, so no second hand list is left unpinned.

## Is the declared set reachable at runtime?

Yes. `ChartType` itself is type-only, but its set exists as a value: the spec's `ChartTypeSchema` is a zod enum, and `ChartSchema.chartType` uses it by reference through objectui's `ChartTypeSchema` in `packages/types/src/zod/data-display.zod.ts`. The pin does three things:

- It reads `shapeEnumOptions(ChartSchema, 'chartType')`, the node's own declaration, on every run.
- It holds that set equal to the installed spec's `ChartTypeSchema` options.
- At compile time, it holds the TS face to the zod face, and `ChartType` to the spec's `ChartType`. That check runs under `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`, the third leg of the package's `type-check`.

Nothing in the test writes the set out, so the row is asked to follow the installed spec when objectui#11438's bump lands.

## The pin

`packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-type-doc-row-11521.test.ts` follows the shape of objectui#11491's `grid-columns-set-11491.test.ts`: the declared set on the zod face, both doors, and a compile-time check that the faces state one set. The doc side is parsed off disk the way `schema-reference-named-list-view-keys-7923.test.ts` reads this page: the repo root is found from `import.meta.url`, and a moved heading, a renamed property or a row with no quoted values throws instead of passing.

- The row's quoted values equal the declared set, with no value listed twice.
- The declared set is the installed spec's `ChartTypeSchema`.
- On both faces, every value the row lists parses green. `heatmap` is refused at `chartType` as one `invalid_value` whose `values` are the declared set. That is the row's "refused with the set named".
- The TS face, the zod face and the spec's `ChartType` state one set (compile-time).

## Mutation proof

The fix was committed first (`9e4bfca`), and the mutations ran on `61749c7`. Every mutation went through `objectstack/scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode. For each one, the tool confirmed the anchor hit once and the blob changed. After each one, it confirmed the restore: the blob equals HEAD and `git diff HEAD` is empty. The tree after all legs: `git diff HEAD` is 0 bytes.

| leg | mutation | reading |
|---|---|---|
| G0 | none | `Tests  8 passed (8)` |
| M1 | `"heatmap"` re-added to the row | `Tests  3 failed / 5 passed (8)`: the row equality, plus "accepts every family the row lists" on both faces (`chartType "heatmap" refused`) |
| M2 | `"pivot"` dropped from the row | `Tests  1 failed / 7 passed (8)`: the row equality |
| M3 | the node's declared set drops `pivot` (`ChartTypeSchema.exclude(['pivot'])` at `ChartSchema.chartType`) | `Tests  4 failed / 4 passed (8)`: spec equality, row equality, and "accepts every family the row lists" on both faces (`chartType "pivot" refused`) |
| M4 | the TS face drops `pivot` (`ChartType` becomes `Exclude` of the spec type minus `pivot`) | `tsc -p tsconfig.test.json` exits 2 with 5 errors. Two are in this file: the `tsIsSpec` and `facesAgree` checks (`Type 'true' is not assignable to type 'false'`). The other three are in the existing `spec-derived-unions.test.ts` and `zod-mirror-parity.test.ts`. |

The red came out in the expected direction every time. None of these legs needed a rebuild: the test imports `../zod/*.js` from source, and `@objectstack/spec` is the installed package, not a workspace build.

## Other hand-written enum rows on this page (named, not fixed)

Each row was compared with its declaration by a one-off probe: zod enum options through `shapeEnumOptions`, or the TS union where the zod schema is a lazy one. This is a reading taken on 2026-10-03 at `61749c7`. Nothing re-derives it.

- **Match their declaration:**
  - `PageNodeSchema.pageType`, `CardSchema.variant`, `GridSchema.gap`, and the breakpoint names in `GridSchema.columns`;
  - `TabsSchema.orientation`, `FormSchema.layout`, `FormSchema.validationMode`, `InputSchema.inputType`;
  - `ButtonSchema.variant` / `size` / `iconPosition` / `buttonType`;
  - `ChartSchema.series`: the per-series `type`, `yAxis` and `variant`;
  - `ActionSchema.actionType` / `method` / `chainMode`;
  - `ObjectFormSchema.mode` / `formType` / `layout` / `drawerSide` / `modalSize`, and `ObjectKanbanSchema.navigation`'s `mode`;
  - `ObjectViewSchema.defaultViewType`, `CalendarViewSchema.view`, `DetailViewSchema.layout`, `ViewSwitcherSchema.variant` / `position`.
- **Omit declared values.** This is the same class as this card's omission half. They are not changed here, per the dispatch's file surface, and are reported to the seat:
  - `ActionSchema.level` lists six values. Both faces declare a seventh, `"default"`.
  - `ViewSwitcherSchema.defaultView` (type `ViewType`) lists seven values. Both faces declare eleven: the extra four are `gallery`, `gantt`, `chart` and `tree`.
- **Not an enum:** `BaseSchema.type` lists example registry keys.

## Acceptance notes

- **The inline `chart` node still declares families it draws no chart of.** `object-chart` narrowed `chartType` to the thirteen families plugin-charts draws in objectui#11513. The inline `chart` node still declares all twenty, and for seven of them it draws a number or a notice. Whether it should narrow too is a contract question for the seat, not this card. The row follows the declaration as it stands.
- **No overlap with objectui#11512.** That draft edits only this page's opening section, far from this row.

## Gates

All gates ran on `61749c7` (`git rev-parse --short HEAD`), the final commit. Exit codes were captured before any pipe.

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/types/src/__tests__/chart-type-doc-row-11521.test.ts`: `Tests  8 passed (8)`.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/types run type-check` (echoed `tsc --noEmit && tsc -p tsconfig.examples.json && tsc -p tsconfig.test.json`): exit 0.
- **The doc-reader union**, 29 files: every test that names `schema-reference` (`git grep -l 'schema-reference' -- '*.test.ts' '*.test.tsx'`) plus every test that walks `content/docs` (`git grep -l -E` for a quoted `content/docs` root). Run as `pnpm exec vitest run --maxWorkers=1` over those 29 files: `Test Files  29 passed (29)`, `Tests  1117 passed (1117)`.
- `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: exit 0. It reports `1 changeset(s): .changeset/11521-chart-type-doc-row.md`, and every changeset has an EMPTY frontmatter, which it calls "the explicit exemption and a complete answer to this gate".
- `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`: exit 0.
- `pnpm run check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (`0 new citation(s)`), `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `type-check:coverage` (`43/43 packages compile their tests`), `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids` and `check:doc-types` (`Every documented component type is registered.`): all exit 0.
- **Lint, a proven narrowing.** `pnpm exec eslint --no-inline-config --format json` over the one new source file reports 1 file, 0 errors and 0 warnings.
  - The file is in the lint population. `eslint --print-config` on it resolves 118 rules, among them `object-ui/no-line-address-in-test-name`, and no ignore warning was raised.
  - The narrowing cannot hide a verdict elsewhere. The resolved `parserOptions` is empty, so linting is not type-aware, and this diff cannot move the verdict on any file it does not touch.

**Verification narrowing, declared.** The shared verify lock was held throughout by objectui#11438's full run (pid 14877, more than 75 minutes). This branch's slot queued three times, 540s each, and each attempt returned `queue-timeout (exit 99)`. Per the dispatch's queue rules, everything above ran outside the lock, and only as targeted runs: one test file, one package type-check, and the 29-file union at `--maxWorkers=1`. **Not run locally:** the full `@object-ui/types` vitest suite (345 files) and the repo-wide suite and lint. Those belong to CI.

**Blind spot of the union.** It finds tests by the literal page name and by a quoted docs root. A test that reaches this page through another spelling is not in it.
